scope: Python build orchestration and source staging; Android SDK command results are synthetic. No APK compilation, signing, emulator, or physical-device testing.
regression_proof: Before repair, 13 subcases across seven rejection/compile scenarios failed; after repair all grouped checks passed.
production_fix: Use a disposable candidate output directory. Copy the APK and receipts to release dist only after compilation and every validation succeeds. Prior validated release survives rejected candidates.
native_static_review: No INTERNET permission; external source links require explicit user gesture and open outside the WebView.
Bridge exposes bounded text/binary save, user-directed share, and print; no untrusted remote documents execute.
Picker inputs use private read-only URI copies, canonical path checks, count/per-file/total caps, and callback cleanup.
Physical picker/process recreation/WebView/print behavior remains unverified.
